gloss: quite a struggle; a hard time

definitions.gloss: quite a struggle; a hard time; a real effort
definitions.explanation: Describes a task or situation that requires considerable effort or trouble. Used when something turns out to be more difficult than expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一苦労|ひとくろう}だった。
examples.english: Finding a parking spot was quite a struggle.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{一苦労|ひとくろう}だ。
examples.english: Just waking the kids up every morning is a real effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三階|さんがい}→三階：27617_sangai⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一苦労|ひとくろう}だ。
examples.english: Carrying large furniture up to the third floor is quite a task.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically used with だ or だった to describe a completed or ongoing difficulty. The pattern ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一苦労|ひとくろう}だ (doing X is quite a struggle) is very common. Despite the literal meaning of "one hardship," it emphasizes that something is unexpectedly troublesome.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一苦労|ひとくろう}だ (doing X is quite a struggle)
- {一苦労|ひとくろう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have a hard time)
- {一苦労|ひとくろう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{二苦労|ふたくろう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (not just one but many hardships)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧: hardship, trouble — broader and more general, not limited to a single difficult task
- ⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧: effort, bother — focuses on the time and labor required rather than difficulty
